summary: SP Kapan module — end-to-end verified. Added 12 new backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_sp_kapan.py covering: SP-vs-normal register isolation, SP stone creation (S-prefixed codes, pcs=1, un-packeted drops, over-weight rejection, SP-only endpoint), issue rules (SP+normal mix rejected, Nats & Filling rejected for SP, bad sub-packet split rejected, valid sub-packet split accepted with sub_packets carried on entry, receive keeps pcs=1 even when payload return_pcs=5, stone chain accumulates loss across marking->laser), karigar-not-registered rejection, and sp-report shape (kapan_weight, stone_count, loss/yield_pct per stone, balanced flag). Full pytest suite is 81/81 green (69 existing regression + 12 new SP). Frontend (Playwright): logged in as admin, verified nav-sp-kapans opens sp-kapans-page; created new SP kapan UISP6131 (weight 120.50) — it appears only in the SP register and is absent from the normal Kapan register; SP detail page loads with data-testid sp-kapan-detail-page and Add-Stones dialog persisted 2 stones which rendered as chain cards; existing seed SP436.57 with 2 stones still present. Packet Issue: opened issue-dialog, switched issue-kind-select to sp, opened issue-process-select and confirmed nats & filling options are absent while marking, sarine, laser, shape, ghat, polish, table_polish are all present; SP mode auto-loads Marking stock ("Marking stock — 4 packet(s) available") from the seed SP kapans; a bad scan surfaces the expected toast. Existing 69 backend regression tests remain green — nothing regressed.

critical_code_review_comments: create_jangad correctly enforces SP↔normal isolation and SP_PROCESSES membership BEFORE karigar check — order is fine.
receive_entry hard-codes ret_pcs=1 for mode='sp' so stones can never split into multiple pcs, matching the spec.
sub_packets validation uses tolerance 0.011 which matches the frontend splitBad threshold — good symmetry.
sp-report.difference = original - (current + loss + rc + nail_rc) is a nice per-stone identity, complementing the kapan-level reconciliation.
next_packet_code('S') and next_packet_code() share the SAME global counter — so an S25165 stone and a 25166 normal packet can co-exist without clashes; this matches the requested global numbering.
server.py is now 1426 lines — SP endpoints packed in without splitting. Consider extracting sp_kapan / jangads / entries into domain routers for maintainability (still non-blocking).

rca of the issue: Not a bug hunt this iteration — this was a feature verification for the newly built SP Kapan module. Everything specified in the review request (nav, register isolation, S-prefixed codes with pcs=1, un-packeted-drop, over-weight rejection, chain rendering with rough/current/loss/yield, SP-only process list of 7 excluding Nats & Filling, SP-only stock filter, sub-packet split validation on both UI (splitBad → disabled Issue button) and API (400 with clear message), mix-rejection, Nats/Filling rejection on API, karigar rule, receive maths (loss = issue - boil, pcs stays 1, chain step appears), re-issue for another process with cumulative loss, existing kapan/packet regression) is working. 12 new backend tests exercise every rule and pass alongside all 69 pre-existing tests.
